text.description_html:
Deltana DSB66BB3-UNL-NRP 6" x 6" x Square Corners with 4 Ball Bearings Solid Brass Hinge

Package includes a pair of hinges (2), matching solid brass flathead, Phillips Drive #14 x 1-1/2" wood screws and standard removable button tip finials.

Fitted with a high grade, non-removable, rust resistant, stainless steel pin. Utilizes template screw hole pattern for use with wood or metal doors.

Specifications:

  • Height: 6"
  • Width: 6"
  • Corners: Square
  • Quad Ball-Bearing: 4BB
  • Thickness: 0.205"
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Hinge Pin: Stainless Steel
  • Wood Screws: #14 x 1-1/2"
  • Hinge Material: Solid Brass
  • Finish: Un-lacquered Brass
  • Deltana DSB66BB3-UNL-NRP Hinge Specifications (PDF)

Available to use with the Ball Tip Finial.

*Sold in Pairs (2 Hinges)
